name_en: Amakusa tai somen — somen noodles simmered in the broth of a whole simmered sea bream
summary_ja: タイの頭や中骨を煮た「あら炊き」の煮汁でそうめんを煮て食べる祝い料理。そうめんを使うのは特産地・島原の食文化の影響とされる。山都町馬見原では鯛を丸ごと姿煮にする「鯛めん」として伝わるという。
summary_en: Somen noodles are simmered in the broth of sea bream head and bones cooked down whole — a celebratory dish said to reflect the influence of nearby Shimabara's somen tradition. In Yamato's Mamihara, a version called "taimen" simmers the whole fish instead.
source_title: 鯛そうめん 熊本県

name_en: Taipiien — a Chinese-style glass noodle soup topped with a deep-fried hard-boiled egg
summary_ja: 春雨を主役に、豚肉やエビ、野菜を炒めて煮込んだ中華風スープに、揚げたゆで卵をのせた麺料理。中国福建省の祝い料理がルーツとされ、明治後期に長崎経由で熊本に伝わった華僑の味という。
summary_en: Glass noodles anchor a Chinese-style soup of stir-fried pork, shrimp, and vegetables, topped with a deep-fried hard-boiled egg. Said to trace back to a festive Fujian dish, brought by Chinese immigrants via Nagasaki in the late Meiji era.
